Players max: 2, 4, 8, 12 or 16, host included (8 by default), in the Options card. Above 10, you need a very good connection and a good machine on the host's side.
My outfits: save what you are wearing under a name (12 outfits at most, per game), put it back on with one click. An imported image stays unique: the outfit shows the current image.

The Character page also has the Outfit, Face, Car tabs in the header. On the left, the 3D preview (Full, Portrait or Wheel): drag to turn, wheel to zoom. On the right, the tiles with their 3D thumbnail, per body part; the \"+ N\" tile shows the rest. RANDOM draws an outfit, SAVE keeps it.
Save several outfits under the name of your choice (work, weekend, rally) and put them back on with one click: Character page, My outfits tab.
New line in the bar, under Guide: everything MWCoop shares between players, what each player keeps to themselves, and what to do if something differs.
Everything MWCoop shares between the players of the same game. The world is the host's: their save goes to the guests at the start of the game.
The players
Where they are and their moves, outfits and faces, proximity voice, chat, shared markers, punches (if the host allows them).
The cars
Driver and passengers, doors, dashboard, windows, crashes, towing, fuel.
Mechanics: parts, bolts, tuning, fluids, paint, leaks and steam.
The CORRIS and My Winter Car's vehicles, parked cars, the Fiad 131 and the add-on cars.
SATSUMA, GIFU, KEKMET, HAYOSIKO, FERNDALE, RUSCKO, JONNEZ, FLATBED, the boat, the Fiad 131 and the add-on cars.
The world
The host's time and weather, traffic, NPCs, doors, machines, the radio, fires, the sauna.
Items: what you move, drink, eat or cook, shelves and display cabinets.
Shops, jobs and phone calls.
Races and additions
The rally and the ice race.
The rally and the drag races, with everyone's times and trophies.
MWCoop additions (s21 shop, cinema, museum, Ässäkylä...): the ones the host chose, for everyone.
The host's mods and content (CDs, radio, images): sent to their guests, with their OK for the mods.
What each player keeps
Your settings: graphics, HUD, keys, volume. Your solo save: a guest plays in a separate profile.
Your money, your crimes and jail, your objectives on the map.
Not synced
A mod MWCoop doesn't support: what it adds is only seen by those who have it, and it can create differences.
Something differs on your side? F10 > Sync > Resync the world: the host resends you its whole state, as on your arrival (once per 30 s). If it comes back: Report a bug, the bug icon at the top right.
